svg.text: Composite PRIMARY KEY: (scheme_id, category_id); both attributes are foreign keys.
Underlined attributes = primary key. Arrows point from a foreign key to its referenced primary key.
Wrapped rows belong to the same relation. Crossing reference lines do not represent a junction.
Mapping: strong entities; FK-based 1:1 and 1:N relationships; SCHEME_CATEGORIES resolves M:N; category hierarchy uses a self-FK.
Derived age is not stored. No additional weak-entity, multivalued-attribute or n-ary mapping is needed for this schema.
